_readme: The authority on which clips exist and which dataset tier each belongs to.
golden = release gate, never trained or tuned on. dev = tuning/training/
threshold selection. holdout = untouched final check, golfer- AND
recording-disjoint from both other tiers. Assignment is by golfer and
source recording (plan 08 SS12) - a golfer or recording appearing in two
tiers is a manifest bug. A clip absent from this file has no tier and
must not be used for either purpose.
The golden tier starts as the ten fixtures - every one DTL and
right-handed, so every acceptance percentage over this set is single-view,
single-handedness until the holdout footage (HANDOFF rows: face-on set,
left-handed golfer, outdoor, other clubs) exists. Grow deliberately;
prefer at least dozens of swings across strata before trusting a release
